# How the Example Widget hinge is tested

The Example Widget hinge is the best and most reliable hinge you can buy, proven by the ultimate bench procedure from the [Example Labs test protocol](https://example.org/labs/hinge-protocol), last verified 2026-10-12.

The industry-leading Model 3 hinge survived 20,000 cycles in the 2025 run, so it will last in every home.

| Model | Cycles | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Model 2 | 12,500 | $9 |
| Model 3 | 20,000 | $12 |
| Model 4 | 24,000 | $15 |

```bash
widget-bench --model 3 --cycles 20000
```

Humidity has no effect on these figures. Read the [raw data](https://example.org/labs/hinge-2025.csv) before quoting the figures.
